capabilities: Run Pomodoro sessions with a tree that grows as the ring fills
Build a floating village with islands, buildings, crops and a Heart Tree
Start a session from a Markdown task or a Kanban card
Log sessions to daily notes in a Dataview-friendly format
Export the village as a self-contained animated HTML page
extras: No account, server or tracking; all data is kept in .obsidian/plugins/pomodoro-timer-forest/data.json and must be backed up before uninstalling. Detailed instructions live in an external user guide rather than the README.
intentEvidence: Built on Pomodoro Timer for Obsidian by eatgrass (MIT), which provides the timer, task tracking and logging.
motivation: It is made for brains that tune out a plain countdown and give up on apps that punish a bad week.
problem: A plain countdown is easy to ignore, and most Pomodoro apps punish a missed day by wiping out progress.

relations.evidence: Built on Pomodoro Timer for Obsidian by eatgrass (MIT), which provides the timer, task tracking and logging.
Boards use the Obsidian Kanban file format, so boards you already have open as they are.

summary: Pomodoro focus timer that grows a tree each session and builds a floating village with islands, buildings and sleeping streaks.
